ACME Dev: Hey @support — invoice came back ~30% higher than our local estimator. Using JS SDK streaming + a custom header `X-Client-Meta`. SDK shows ~420 tokens but invoice shows ~540. Any idea?
Sam Support: Sorry about that, can you paste a minimal curl or SDK call and the invoice request-id?
ACME Dev: repro curl:```curl -i -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Client-Meta: env=staging;team=payments\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize transactions."}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat```
ACME Dev: our JS SDK v0.9.3 estimateTokens(...) => 420. Invoice request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d.
Priya Eng: thanks. Can you also capture response headers? we put some metering hints in headers (`x-token-ack`, `x-token-metered`).
ACME Dev: headers from server:```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-token-ack: 420
x-token-metered: 540
content-type: text/event-stream```
MeteringBot: metering-service: detected +120 tokens for injected conversation metadata (session-meta) on rq_0a1b2c3d :warning:
Sam Support: ok that explains the delta. Priya, is that session-meta injection new?
Priya Eng: short answer: yes, when `X-Client-Meta` is present we serialize that as a hidden system-side preamble to the conversation (for routing/observability). It gets counted in meterable tokens but our client-side estimator doesn't see server-side injections. Each key/value pair adds ~12 tokens in this account's tokenization profile.
ACME Dev: ah — that was unexpected. Is that documented? we send this header for internal tracing.
Priya Eng: not well-documented, sorry. Immediate options: 1) remove the header (workaround) -> estimated and metered align; 2) we can patch SDK to warn when this header is used; 3) longer-term, add a meter-visibility flag to opt-out of server-injected metadata tokens for enterprise customers (requires audit/gating).
Sam Support: for now I recommended removing `X-Client-Meta` in the affected workload to avoid surprise billing. We'll open a doc/update and a small SDK PR to surface a warning in v0.9.4.
ACME Dev: thanks. Also can someone add a note to billing docs about server-side injections so we can communicate to our finance team? :thumbsup:
Priya Eng: noted — I'll file ENG-1256 to track doc + SDK change. LogBot: ENG-1256 created by priya — meter docs + SDK warning.
ACME Dev: appreciated. Leaving the thread open if you need the raw trace.
